[[File:Alternate World Team Rocket.png|250px|thumb|left|Alternate World Team Rocket]] [[File:Alternate World Team Rocket Grunt.png|250px|thumb|Alternate World Team Rocket Grunts]] '''Alternate World Team Rocket''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|平行世界|へいこうせかい}}のロケット{{tt|団|だん}}''' ''Alternate World Rocket-dan'') are recurring characters who first appeared in ''[[JN089|The Gates of Warp!]]''. They are the {{pkmn|multiverse#In animation|Alternate World}} counterparts of {{TRT}}. They briefly appeared between worlds when {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}} were fighting, opening portals to other worlds. They appeared in the main world after an attempt by {{TRT}} to capture {{AP|Pikachu}} sent them blasting off. Using nets fired by {{p|Wobbuffet}}, they were able to capture {{AP|Lucario}} and {{TP|Goh|Inteleon}} and brought them through the portal which caused {{an|Dawn}} and [[Goh]] to follow. They reappeared in the main world where they attempted to capture Pikachu and [[Cynthia's Garchomp]], but were stopped when Cynthia sent out her {{p|Kommo-o}}. They retreated through the portal, only to be followed by {{Ash}} and [[Chloe]]. They reappeared in ''[[JN090|Showdown at the Gates of Warp!]]'', along with alternative world counterparts of the {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s from the [[Matori Matrix]]. They used the [[Red Chain]] to hold {{OBP|Dialga|recurring}} and {{OBP|Palkia|recurring}} in combat, causing distortions that resulted in Pokémon [[Devolution|devolving]] back into {{pkmn|Egg}}s. They revealed that they're planning on using Dialga and Palkia's time-space powers to devolve every Pokémon so they can recreate them as a very powerful army big enough to take over worlds. They and their Pokémon wore armor that prevented them from deaging. However, their arrogance and overconfidence in misusing Dialga's temporal powers, Palkia's spatial powers, and the Red Chain proved to be their undoing as it destroyed their armor, devolved their own Pokémon into Eggs (with the exception of {{p|Meowth}} and Wobbuffet) and blasted them and their grunts off through one of the portals. {{-}} ==Pokémon== ===Traveling with=== {{TrainerPoké |nick=Meowth |type1=Normal |gender=male |img=Alternate World Team Rocket Meowth.png |epnum=JN089 |epname=The Gates of Warp! |vajp=Inuko Inuyama |vaen=James Carter Cathcart |desc={{p|Meowth}} is Jessie and James's partner. Unlike the main world's {{MTR}}, he is a powerful battler, able to keep up with [[Cynthia's Garchomp]]. Meowth's known moves are {{m|Dark Pulse}} and {{m|Slash}}.}} ===Alternate World Jessie=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Alternate World Jessie |pkmn=Wobbuffet |type1=Psychic |gender=male |img=Alternate World Jessie Wobbuffet.png |epnum=JN089 |epname=The Gates of Warp! |vajp=Yūji Ueda |vaen=Erica Schroeder |desc={{p|Wobbuffet}} is Alternate World Jessie's only known Pokémon. Wobbuffet was used to fire a net at Pokémon that they were planning to capture and succeeded in catching [[Goh's Inteleon]] and [[Ash's Lucario]] and later attempted to catch [[Ash's Pikachu]] and [[Cynthia's Garchomp]]. None of Wobbuffet's moves are known.}} ===Alternate World Grunts=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Team Rocket |pkmn=Toxicroak |type1=Poison |type2=Fighting |img=Alternate World Team Rocket Toxicroak Purugly.png |epnum=JN090 |epname=Showdown at the Gates of Warp! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Toxicroak}} was used by an Alternate World Team Rocket Grunt.
